releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.62 applies only the first approved organization phase. Home, Files, Notes, Library and Settings now use one fixed light page-title header with consistent height and placement. Files is split directly under the header into Category and Search: Category contains the restored real File Summary plus the existing category organization and helper tools, while Search opens directly to the existing filename/type search and filters. No app functions are removed or changed, and broader spacing, Refresh and cross-page layout refinements are intentionally deferred until this phase is reviewed.
